actions.label: ⚡ Process Refund
actions.description: Trigger this when a customer requests a refund and is eligible.

actions.label: ⚡ Cancel Subscription
actions.description: Trigger this to immediately cancel a customer's subscription.

actions.label: ⚡ Send Password Reset
actions.description: Trigger this when a customer is locked out or forgot password.

actions.label: ⚡ Escalate to Tier 2
actions.description: Trigger this when the issue is too complex or the customer is highly frustrated.

macros.content: Hi there! Thanks for reaching out to Infosys Springboard support. How can I help you today?
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused you. Let me look into this right away.
As per our policy, refunds can be processed within 3 days of the latest renewal. I will check your account to see if you are eligible.
To proceed, could you please confirm the email address associated with your account?
